about: Every message between the Python core and the Tauri UI. Read by protocol.py and ui/src/protocol.ts; nothing else defines a message. Field types: string, integer, number, boolean, object, array, or a list of allowed strings. A trailing ? marks an optional field. Unknown fields are rejected.

hello.doc: First message of every connection, within 2 s, or the core closes it.

ping.doc: A request: the core answers with reply, carrying the same id.

request.doc: Ask the core for data or to change something, by method name (rpc.py lists them). It must carry an id; the core answers with reply, carrying the same id.

ask.doc: A question typed in the panel, with the capture confirmed for it, if any.

capture.start.doc: A capture gesture chosen in the UI (a chip, a menu entry).

capture.region.doc: The rectangle the user selected after capture.select, in logical pixels of that screen.

capture.file.doc: A file dropped on the avatar.

capture.window.doc: Ctrl + drag of the avatar released here: capture the window under this point (physical desktop pixels).

guide.active.doc: The guide cursor is shown (true) or gone (false): the core holds Escape only in between.

cloak.ack.doc: This window is hidden; the core may grab the screen.

action.doc: A menu or tray entry with no payload of its own.

reply.doc: The answer to a request, with the request's id.

error.doc: A message the core refused, with the offending message's id when it had one.

connection.doc: The link to Claude Code: connecting, online, offline...

system.doc: Machine load, for the tray tooltip.

appearance.doc: The avatar's look and what the windows hide from screen shares (config.toml). Sent on connect and after each reload.

quiet.doc: A fullscreen game, video or presentation: hide everything until off.

panel.open.doc: Open the panel, from a hotkey or after a capture was confirmed.

stream.start.doc: A question was sent; an answer is coming.

stream.status.doc: What Claude is doing right now (a tool, a search).

stream.reset.doc: Throw away the answer so far; it restarts.

approval.request.doc: Silence is refusal: past timeout_seconds the core denies on its own and sends approval.cancel.

capture.select.doc: Let the user draw a rectangle on screen, then answer with capture.region or capture.cancel.

capture.preview.doc: Exactly what would be sent. Nothing leaves without capture.confirm.

selection.menu.doc: Text was selected: offer the actions, answer with selection.pick.

guide.point.doc: Logical pixels relative to the top-left corner of screen_id.

guide.steps.doc: A tutorial; each step is {text, target} where target is null or shaped like guide.point / guide.highlight with a kind field.

cloak.hide.doc: Hide every window, then answer cloak.ack. Without an ack in time, the capture is abandoned.

window.open.doc: Open a window: the avatar page opens the app window on that view (palette opens the panel's command bar). onboarding is also sent on connect until the welcome is dismissed.
